evidence: The chemical composition of the coating on carbon fibers was investigated using energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDXS), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy. The roughness of the samples was investigated using XRR and atomic force microscopy (AFM). Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) was performed to investigate the oxidation protection provided by the titanium phosphate coating. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images were used to measure the coating thickness and observe the surface morphology. X-ray reflectometry (XRR) measurements were performed on silicon wafers coated with titanium phosphate. The coating thickness was measured via SEM. The oxidation protection provided by the coating was investigated using thermogravimetric analysis (TGA).
